BOYCOTT @Charlotte Tilbury 🚫 CT is NO LONGER Cruelty Free Certified!😱 Charlotte Tilbury has officially stated they are not adopting Cruelty Free International’s new logo “to avoid confusion among different markets”. This is not only confusing but also misleading. Without third party auditing, they are free to do as they please. No checks. No balances. This is a MAJOR red flag in my book 🚩🚩 Check out my other CF creator friends: @Sam McGraw 🐶 @angelina rivera 🧚🏼‍♀️✨ @Grace | cruelty-free 🐰 @Jess | veganbeautyaddict @Hales  #charlottetilbury #boycott #animaltesting #crueltyfree

Bye, Darling. No more @Charlotte Tilbury for the cruelty-free community.  THE TEA: Charlotte Tilbury has now publicly announced on their website they will not be renewing their Cruelty Free International certification.  THE BACKSTORY: Cruelty Free International (previously also referred to as The Leaping Bunny Programme) is the international coalition partner to Leaping Bunny (who certified North America). They recently announced a rebrand with a new logo. Both programs remain coalition partners with the same rigorous program, just certifying different regions.  THE WHY:  Allegedly, they are concerned about the public perception of this rebrand and its potential to cause confusion  THE ISSUE: 1. Charlotte Tilbury never has to print the rebranded logo on their packaging if they find the new logo from the previous bunny confusing. If they can write the giant chunk of text as their cruelty-free policy they recently revised, then they could have just as easily explained the rebrand and continued commitment.  2. Charlotte Tilbury now claims to be cruelty-free with zero audits, annual renewals, and is left unchecked selling on China where the brand could potentially begin selling their special use goods (which are subject to animal testing) in China. We are just expected to trust them.  3. Charlotte Tilbury is owned by parent company Puig with a large portfolio of other major brands all subject to animal testing as well. CT was the only cruelty-free brand in their collection. It makes this move extra questionable.  Shoutout and thanks to my friends @angelina rivera 🧚🏼‍♀️✨ @Sam McGraw 🐶 @Eli Levi for also jumping on this and their commentary/thoughts as well. Tarte 3 Chocolats Sans Cuisson Ingrédients Base biscuitée • 150 g de biscuits au cacao  • 60 g de beurre fondu Ganache au chocolat blanc • 125 g de crème liquide entière • 240 g de chocolat blanc Ganache au chocolat au lait • 125 g de crème liquide entière • 188 g de chocolat au lait Ganache au chocolat noir • 125 g de crème liquide entière • 105 g de chocolat noir Préparation Préparez la base biscuitée Réduisez les biscuits en poudre fine. Ajoutez le beurre fondu et mélangez jusqu'à obtenir une texture de sable humide. Versez le mélange dans un moule à tarte ou un cercle de 20 cm de diamètre. Tassez fermement le fond ainsi que les bords à l'aide du dos d'une cuillère ou d'un verre. Placez au réfrigérateur pendant 30 minutes. Préparez la ganache au chocolat blanc Hachez finement le chocolat blanc et placez-le dans un saladier. Faites chauffer la crème jusqu'à frémissement, puis versez-la sur le chocolat.  mélangez délicatement du centre vers l'extérieur jusqu'à obtenir une ganache parfaitement lisse. Versez la ganache sur la base biscuitée froide. Placez au réfrigérateur pendant 45 minutes à 1 heure, jusqu'à ce que la surface soit suffisamment ferme pour accueillir la couche suivante. Préparez la ganache au chocolat au lait Hachez le chocolat au lait et déposez-le dans un saladier. Portez la crème à frémissement puis versez-la sur le chocolat. Laissez reposer 1 minute puis mélangez jusqu'à obtenir une texture lisse et brillante. Versez délicatement cette ganache sur la couche de chocolat blanc bien prise.  Placez à nouveau au réfrigérateur pendant 45 minutes à 1 heure. Préparez la ganache au chocolat noir Hachez le chocolat noir et placez-le dans un saladier. Faites chauffer la crème jusqu'à frémissement puis versez-la sur le chocolat.  Versez délicatement sur la couche de chocolat au lait. 🇬🇧 No-Bake Triple Chocolate Tart Ingredients Biscuit Base • 150 g cocoa biscuits • 60 g melted butter White Chocolate Ganache • 125 g heavy cream • 240 g white chocolate Milk Chocolate Ganache • 125 g heavy cream • 188 g milk chocolate Dark Chocolate Ganache • 125 g heavy cream • 105 g dark chocolate Preparation Prepare the Biscuit Base Crush the biscuits into a fine powder. Add the melted butter and mix until you get a texture similar to wet sand. Pour the mixture into a tart pan or a 20 cm pastry ring. Firmly press it onto the base and up the sides using the back of a spoon or a glass. Place in the refrigerator for 30 minutes. Prepare the White Chocolate Ganache Finely chop the white chocolate and place it in a bowl. Heat the cream until it begins to simmer, then pour it over the chocolate. Mix gently from the center outward until the ganache is perfectly smooth. Pour the ganache over the chilled biscuit base. Place in the refrigerator for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until the surface is firm enough to support the next layer. Prepare the Milk Chocolate Ganache Finely chop the milk chocolate and place it in a bowl. Bring the cream to a simmer, then pour it over the chocolate. Let it sit for 1 minute, then stir until smooth and glossy. Carefully pour this ganache over the set white chocolate layer. Return to the refrigerator for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Prepare the Dark Chocolate Ganache Finely chop the dark chocolate and place it in a bowl. Heat the cream until it begins to simmer, then pour it over the chocolate. Carefully pour the ganache over the milk chocolate layer.

📚Remember Anything With These Tricks 1. Mnemonics: create an acronym or silly phrase using the first letters of a list you need to memorize. 2. The Memory Palace: visualize walking through your house and 'placing' facts in specific rooms. 3. Rhymes and songs make information sticky — set boring content to a tune and it becomes unforgettable. 4. Association: link new information to something you already know well. New knowledge needs an anchor. 5. Repetition with variation: say it, write it, draw it, teach it. Four formats = four times the retention. 6. The weirder your memory trick, the more effective it is. Bizarre associations are impossible to forget. #StudyTok #StudyMotivation #ExamPrep #StudyHacks #StudyWithMe

Ooey-Gooey Scoopable Nutella Cookie Pie🤤 Yields: 15-16 Chunky Cookies INGREDIENTS:  230g Cold Chopped Unsalted Butter  160g Caster Sugar  160g Light Brown Sugar  450g Chocolate Chunks or chips  475g Plain Flour  1 tsp Salt 3 tsp Baking Powder  3/4 tsp Baking Soda  2 Eggs  1 Egg Yolk  1 tsp Vanilla  INSTRUCTIONS: •Cut cling wrap into small squares. Scoop ½ teaspoon Nutella onto individual cling-wrap squares. Fold to seal and freeze until solid. (Repeat for however many Nutella stuffed cookies you plan to make.) •In a large mixing bowl, add the cold cubed butter and whisk until slightly creamy. Add the white sugar and light brown sugar, then whisk together until well combined and fluffy. •Add the eggs, vanilla extract, and chocolate chips or chunks.
